## Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Audios
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100095

## Streaming Audios
This article goes over the available settings to edit the Streaming Audios section on the homepage of the website. This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively. This homepage widget will display the Recent Audios posts. To edit these settings, navigate to:
In the Admin Sidebar Open Settings
Select Designs Settings
Open The Homepage Tab
Open The Module Select Content to Display
Select The Streaming Audios Option
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144021959/original/znQciGV-GZr8csTDBVSej9TOCeVcn39dQg.png?1717022172 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022015/original/_-Hw_QvdMxvJ8lv_GOrWF3F-IvtmxadKMA.png?1717022335 | alt: ]

## Visual Guide of the Streaming Audios
This is a representation of the available settings for the Streaming Audios settings.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022130/original/_mzVLdh-BnXSOfjP6K4TXDuT3wFXD-7m5A.png?1717022519 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022179/original/dbuC6aP06owOILepIq4A2f-Wt6fVcCprXw.png?1717022598 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022194/original/FW-j7fTSd5yaZlBNqdZTpfvbboTLUsN7wg.png?1717022663 | alt: ]

## 1. Recent Audios Title
This setting allows the administrator to set the title for the recent audios section. The title can be customized by entering the desired text in the provided input field.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022365/original/FC7-twZo8ad6VkSgjTr_lCjAO5Tx4MhlcA.png?1717022922 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022382/original/nRA7o-0kvK64gy1XNR8veaby2Kd1aG7D8g.png?1717022947 | alt: ]

## 2. Title Color
The title color setting enables the customization of the title's color. Administrators can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022555/original/rK-k3BNC_Xp9dbNpv5rI6gQL-JoUU359pw.png?1717023185 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022494/original/-K8P8Ph_O7fQcHQ5Vjl1UBw4G2nwQdaWdg.png?1717023117 | alt: ]

## 3. Display Options
This setting controls the number of recent audios displayed. Administrators can select from a range of options, from 1 to 24 results. Additionally, the layout can be adjusted to show a specific number of results per row, ranging from 2 to 4 results per row.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022648/original/AmxsRLXxPRRVLDod417vygEtnI570nEXLA.png?1717023243 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022625/original/nAkERPaaumfnG8IAxRx-AXzTwzGdcB9iQQ.png?1717023202 | alt: ]

## 4. Enable Carousel Slider
The carousel slider option allows recent audios to be displayed in a sliding carousel format. This can be toggled on or off using the provided dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022731/original/HaM7h8CPvchCeUbEJOdFmSKn_bnEJm0Yuw.png?1717023402 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022729/original/tndaE-qsJN3YD_HI_d2bYmhmNBukN2ow9w.png?1717023388 | alt: ]

## 5. Hide On Mobile
This setting allows administrators to choose whether the recent audios section should be hidden on mobile devices. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022756/original/hYu85H-8UP6M-Z5rR1Hvn0rFD90QnmFcBA.png?1717023454 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022765/original/3Pyf1uo3VKTzCFArRiFdNH31T0lSZjmZRQ.png?1717023508 | alt: ]

## 6. Linked Post Type
This setting allows the administrator to select the type of content linked to the recent audios. Options include events, job listings, coupons, videos, SoundCloud posts, website blog articles, community articles, and discussions.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022823/original/TTaHsghKAOPcgmwyZcVzA8AhGqZ9GkjhRA.png?1717023598 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022769/original/y4nYQ4S3yNn427LqddQeB5UqD-sqjPsxJw.png?1717023527 | alt: ]

## 7. Show "View All" Button
The "View All" button allows users to see all recent audios. This setting can be toggled on or off using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022839/original/7xmdIHEDYpvNpIR84LjtZr0nxpBDJ5tDiw.png?1717023649 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144022984/original/G5WpJ4jIdq3tluPJPKEy6ENsjRbh-vUbQA.png?1717023689 | alt: ]

## 8. Hide If No Posts Exist
This setting allows administrators to choose whether the recent audios section should be hidden if no posts exist. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144023063/original/INY5-Nj3bGIKnv_7h2inZkpC8TO8yXaKBQ.png?1717023797 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144023067/original/wLw-TnMsxM7VQgcBHtiEOSLOsyVNpWZfeQ.png?1717023815 | alt: ]

## 9. Only Include Posts from Active Members
This setting specifies whether only posts from active members should be included. Administrators can choose to include posts from active members only or from all members.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144023117/original/f_IVT6pOGnnPQ3ncCovyBCSmSvdNunjHxQ.png?1717023857 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144023067/original/wLw-TnMsxM7VQgcBHtiEOSLOsyVNpWZfeQ.png?1717023815 | alt: ]

## 10. Include Posts from Non-Searchable Members
This setting allows administrators to choose whether to include posts from non-searchable members. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144023120/original/IEg3AyXY_K7d6OfC4Eh4kuqNTNuj7FD1qg.png?1717023905 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144023067/original/wLw-TnMsxM7VQgcBHtiEOSLOsyVNpWZfeQ.png?1717023815 | alt: ]

## 11. Include Posts from Members in These Plans
This setting allows administrators to limit the displayed posts to specific membership plans. Administrators can select the desired membership plans from the provided list.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144023131/original/ePjksY2QORmiLNfVQX0v3ck0moGAjoesAg.png?1717023952 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144023067/original/wLw-TnMsxM7VQgcBHtiEOSLOsyVNpWZfeQ.png?1717023815 | alt: ]

## 12. Display Order
The display order setting determines the order in which recent audios are shown. Options include newest first, oldest first, or random order. This can be customized by selecting the desired option from the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144023152/original/lcEWABBFVI5Os7osS6W-QJtGQrnjeYMJfA.png?1717024040 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144023067/original/wLw-TnMsxM7VQgcBHtiEOSLOsyVNpWZfeQ.png?1717023815 | alt: ]

## 13. Limit One Post per Member?
This setting specifies whether only one post per member should be displayed. Administrators can choose to display one post per member or allow multiple posts from the same member.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144023168/original/qbIlYwXWyQ-CW0VOHG_Q6-V9Zcxp5Eea1Q.png?1717024085 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144023067/original/wLw-TnMsxM7VQgcBHtiEOSLOsyVNpWZfeQ.png?1717023815 | alt: ]
